source: NSE published Equity, ETF, REIT and InvIT CSV masters
classificationPolicy: Require an exact current NSE symbol+series match, EQ series, matching ISIN beginning INE, and absence from NSE ETF/REIT/InvIT lists. Do not infer from names. Non-matches remain unknown.
limitations: Current security masters do not reconstruct delisted security status through all historical dates.
EQ series and matching ISIN plus exclusion lists are a conservative candidate screen, not a legal instrument opinion; ambiguous securities remain outside the eligible universe.
